what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Mauritius in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 440 Mauritian asylum seekers, and Ireland hosted 19.8% of them.
After Ireland, the largest hosts are Australia, the United Kingdom and Italy.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Mauritius, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 15 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 631, at the end of 2024, and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
